answers.question: 180/02 Q1 · Which memory backend should `aof work init` select for a new project? Today it selects graphify: every `aof memory ingest` then sends wiki/work to Claude via the claude-cli extractor, and 177 measured that this changed 0 of 200 recalls. Milestone 180's SPEC says the work stream must not go to a hosted model by default. `local` sends nothing and serves the same records, and the /aof:init text changes with it. Existing projects keep their choice either way.
